title: Fold shipped notes into the 1.0.0 changelog
lead: `__version__` is already `1.0.0`. `[Unreleased]` still holds the user-visible work landed after that section was written, and the tag has not been pushed.
**Not in this slice:** creating or pushing `v1.0.0`, changing `__version__`, or publishing to PyPI. `RELEASING.md` still owns the tag.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: `RELEASING.md` says to move `[Unreleased]` into the version section and leave `[Unreleased]` empty before tagging. PyPI will not accept `1.0.0` again. The current `[1.0.0]` section does not mention `next --ready`, `--require-render`, `list --flag`, effort, lean JSON, `next-id`, the import preamble, the agent skill, the TUI queue order, or the pickup and loop changes this pass adds. Tagging current `main` without that edit publishes a changelog that omits those commands.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `CHANGELOG.md`
- `src/slicer/__init__.py` only to confirm it still reads `1.0.0`

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
1. After the edit, `[Unreleased]` has no Added, Changed, or Fixed notes. Every user-visible bullet that was under `[Unreleased]`, plus the pickup and the agent-loop changes, is under `[1.0.0]`.
2. `__version__` is still `1.0.0`. No tag is created.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Move the shipped notes into `[1.0.0]` in the existing Added, Changed, and Fixed groups. Keep Keep-a-Changelog order. Do this only after the pickup slice and the agent-loop slice are done, so their notes are included. Leave the tag, the PyPI upload, and any version bump unperformed.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: `CHANGELOG.md` has an empty `[Unreleased]` and a `[1.0.0]` section that names the commands above. `slicer check` passes. `git tag --list v1.0.0` is empty.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit. Do not tag or push.
